name: DSC thermal-pathway reconstruction benchmark dataset
description: Dataset supporting 'Thermal pathway reconstruction exposes a reliability gap for AI-guided materials design.' It contains the frozen material and prompt definitions, source-qualified DSC event reference, scored original API and subscription-CLI outcomes, aggregate estimates, event-family summaries, paired protocol-context contrasts, conditional direction and temperature tables, illustrative pathways, and machine-readable verification data. No manuscript file is included.
